name: Gentle Daily Shampoo-Violet Leaf & Muslin

image.alt: Gentle Daily Shampoo for Dog & Cat

gallery.alt: Gentle Daily Shampoo for Dog & Cat

shortDesc:
Most shampoos use synthetic preservatives to extend shelf life and sulphate surfactants to create lather.
This one doesn’t. Furry Tail uses Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate — a probiotic ferment that preserves naturally — and amino acid-derived surfactants that clean without stripping.
99.5% Natural Origin Index per ISO 16128-2 
Gentle enough for every bath – coconut- and sugar-derived surfactants clean without sulphates, so you can bathe as often as the coat needs.
Soothes sensitive skin – colloidal oatmeal, aloe vera and vegetable glycerin support the skin barrier through heat and monsoon.
A grounding fragrance, not a perfume – Violet leaf meets muslin in an IFRA-compliant fine-fragrance identity.
Vet-consulted formula with camellia oil and Vitamin E for a soft, conditioned coat. 
For dogs and cats.
description:
Ingredients

Coconut-Derived Cleanser, Aloe Vera ,Colloidal Oatmeal ,Guar Conditioner, Neem Extract ,Vitamin E

How to use

Wet the coat. Apply a small amount and lather slowly from neck to tail, keeping clear of the eyes. Rinse until the water runs clean. For cats, take extra care around the face.

Safety

Formulated for dogs & cats.

name: Refreshing Mist
shortDesc: A fine-mist coat fragrance for the moments that matter — before guests arrive, before car ride, before the evening cuddle on the sofa. A light water base carries the fragrance through the coat and evaporates clean, leaving yuzu — bright Japanese citrus that opens on contact — and ambrette seed musk, warm and skin-close, that lingers long after. Formulated for daily use. Light enough to layer. Present enough to be noticed.
description:
Key ingredients

Yuzu & White Musk Accord

How to use

Hold 25cm from the coat. Apply 3 to 5 sprays over the back and flanks. Allow to settle naturally — do not rub in. The mist dries into the coat within seconds. Can be used daily or as needed between baths.

Safety

Formulated for dogs; not suitable for cats.

name: Dry Foam Shampoo
shortDesc:
BETWEEN BATHS. WITHOUT WATER.
A full bath every day isn’t always possible. But a coat that smells and feels clean should be. This waterless foam refreshes between bath days — absorbing surface oils, neutralising odour, and leaving a light conditioning finish without a drop of water. No tub. No towelling. Hinoki cypress and fresh bamboo — the scent of a Japanese bathhouse, quiet and architectural. 99.5% Natural Origin Index per ISO 16128-2.
description:
Key ingredients

Acacia Dealbata · Dipteryx Odorata

How to use

Shake well. Hold 15cm from the coat and apply 4–6 sprays from neck to tail. Massage gently through with hands or a soft brush. Allow 60–90 seconds to dry. No rinsing required. Use between bath days as needed.

Safety

Formulated for dogs & cats.
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
Keep out of reach of children. If irritation occurs,
discontinue use and consult your veterinarian.

name: Anti-Tick & Flea Spray
shortDesc:
BEFORE EVERY WALK.
Most tick sprays use synthetic pyrethroids or permethrin — chemical actives that repel through toxicity. This one doesn’t. Vetiver root oil and cypress oil work through scent — plant-derived aromatic compounds that ticks and fleas actively avoid. Neem extract adds a biological deterrent layer. No synthetic pesticides. No permethrin. No DEET. 99.5% Natural Origin Index per ISO 16128-2.
Apply before every walk in tick-active environments — parks, trails, monsoon-wet grass.
This is a plant-derived repellent — not a medicated treatment. For active tick infestations or recurring flea infections, consult your veterinarian.
description:
Key ingredients

Neem Extract, Aloe Vera, Vetiver ,Hinoki Cypress

How to use

Shake well. Hold 20cm from the coat. Apply 6 to 8 sprays covering the back, flanks, and base of the tail. Avoid the eyes and mouth. Allow to dry completely before your dog goes outside. Repeat before each walk in tick-active environments — parks, trails, monsoon-wet grass.

Safety

Not suitable for cats. Avoid eyes, nose and mouth. Patch-test sensitive dogs. For established infestations, consult a vet.

name: Paw Cleaner
shortDesc:
AFTER THE WALK ,AT THE DOOR. EVERY TIME.
Urban walks leave more on paws than visible mud. City pavements carry pesticide residue, construction dust, monsoon bacteria, and road chemicals — all of which travel inside on your dog’s pads. This no-rinse foam lifts surface grit and residue without water, without a tub, and without stripping the pad’s natural skin barrier. Spearmint provides a naturally cooling, deodorising finish. One pump. Thirty seconds. Done at the door.
description:
Key ingredients

Sea Salt , Spearmint ,Oat Extract ,Witch Hazel Water

How to use

Pump a small amount directly onto each paw or onto a damp cloth. Gently massage across each pad and between the toes. Wipe clean with a damp cloth or towel. No rinsing required. Use after every walk.

Safety

Not suitable for cats. Formulated for dogs.
